subject: CLAIM shader-coverage-opus: tessellation (b) - air_bridge.rs NEW tegu_air_render_pipeline_create_tessellated + render_outputs_for tess branch; mali_graphics_compiler.c NEW tess_eval_spirv_as_vertex() + 3-line call at the top of translate_specialized (prefold untouched)
body: Design: the translator's evaluation stage already pulls control points/patch attributes from buffers itself; its only non-VS inputs are TessCoord (vec3) and the control stage's patch inputs: Location0 uint Metal patch index, Location1 uint instance, Location2.. uvec4[ceil(N/4)] control-point element indices (patch*N+k or the control-point index buffer value). The Mali compiler rewrites such a module to a Vertex entry: TessCoord -> Location 30 input, Patch decorations and tess execution modes dropped. api-surface (a) contract for drawPatches: per generated vertex attributes loc0 patch index, loc1 instance index (base included), loc2.. control-point element indices, loc30 position_in_patch (float3: quad uv0 / triangle barycentrics), primitive list = the tessellator's triangles (Metal partition/winding); the pipeline's own vertex buffers bind as usual (control points are pulled from them by the shader).
